modmenu.description.tessera: Native BC7 GPU texture compression and VRAM optimization engine.
tessera.configuration.cache.tooltip: Configure disk cache location for compiled BC7 texture blocks.
tessera.configuration.cacheDirectory.too: Folder name where compiled BC7 texture blocks are stored on disk.
tessera.configuration.compression.toolti: Configure BC7 native compression behavior and animation freezing.
tessera.configuration.compressionQuality: BC7 quality preset (0: Fastest to 7: Highest Fidelity). Controls compression quality vs processing time.
tessera.configuration.debug.tooltip: Configure debug overlay display and extended information on the F3 screen.
tessera.configuration.dedupSimilarityThr: Hamming distance (0-64) for 64-bit pHash fingerprints. Lower values are stricter when merging duplicate sprites.
tessera.configuration.deduplication.tool: Configure perceptual hashing and near-duplicate sprite merging.
tessera.configuration.disableNativeCompr: Forces vanilla RGBA atlas behavior even if BC7 native compression is supported.
tessera.configuration.showExtendedDebugB: Displays the expanded breakdown by atlas and by bucket on the F3 Debug Screen.
tessera.configuration.title: Tessera Settings
tessera.configuration.vramBudget.tooltip: Configure advisory VRAM limits and quality step-down logic.
tessera.configuration.vramBudgetTargetMb: Advisory VRAM memory limit in megabytes evaluated during atlas stitching.
